description.value: Tour de Feast is a small family-run French restaurant tucked into an industrial neighbourhood on the North Shore, drawing loyal locals and visitors with a rotating weekly dinner menu that spans duck confit, lamb rack, and house-made foie gras torchon alongside a weekend brunch and a casual sandwich lineup. The kitchen has earned praise in local press and appeared on Yelp's top Canadian restaurant lists. Outdoor patio seating is available in addition to the indoor dining room.
